title: NOT easy to clean. Smell sticks, but works.
text:
NOT easy to clean. Smell sticks, but works.. I've used this product to make homemade herbamere and to grind down other seasonings. I hope to use it for coffee at some point, but cleaning this is IMPOSSIBLE.

You can't fill it up with water because it will leak down according to the instructions. And you can't take the canister out and put it back to clean it properly. That means you have to use the cloth to rinse and wash it. Problem with this is it's impossible to get under the middle white plastic holding the blades with the brush. Maybe if it was a brush that was smaller and angled up it would properly clean this device. It doesn't though, so you can see the food particles stuck under the white plastic center of the blades by the reflection of the bottom of the place you put the spices/beans.

It's really hard to get the smell out of it too because you can't soak it because I bet the seams by where it spins aren't tight, so it'll leak into the machine. So yeah... Try to find one of these that you can take out the canister and wash it properly.
